description:
Hi, I'm Ofori, a KNUST CompE undergrad & ACES Coding Club Pres blending AI/dev (Angular/ML) with pro motion graphics. For Challenge 09 ("Abandoned but not Forgotten"), I'm building an interactive, gamified web museum of NASA's discarded lunar/Martian hardware. I'm handling frontend, AI, and video.

I need:

Space History Researcher

UI/UX, Pixel, or 3D Artist

Backend Developer

Let's build the greatest outdoor museum in the universe. Reach out!
